name: Financial Party Sector Type 3 Code
definition: Specifies the nature of the reporting counterparty business activities.

AIFD.name: Alternative Investment Fund
AIFD.definition: Alternative investment fund managed by an alternative investment fund manager (AIFM).

CDTI.name: Credit Institution
CDTI.definition: Credit institution that takes deposits or other repayable funds from the public and grants credits for its own account.

ORPI.name: Occupational Retirement Provision Institution
ORPI.definition: Institution for occupational retirement provision established for the purpose of providing retirement benefits in the context of an occupational activity.

REIN.name: Reinsurance Undertaking
REIN.definition: Reinsurance undertaking performing the activity of accepting risks ceded by an insurance undertaking or by another reinsurance undertaking.

UCIT.name: UCITS Management Company
UCIT.definition: Undertaking for collective investment in transferable securities (UCITS) and its management company.
